What this article covers

You carry out “Remove Wordfence gecrasht – – opnieuw install” via wp-admin, files and the hosting panel, with backup awareness and verification.

This long-form guide is written for Remove Wordfence gecrasht – – opnieuw install (slug wordfence-gecrasht-verwijderen-opnieuw-installeren).

Scope

Internal classification: topic wordfence-reinstall — include that context in tickets about “Remove Wordfence gecrasht – – opnieuw install”.

What you need

How to execute

  2. Update core, themes and plugins; remove unused items.
  3. Force password resets for all admins; enable 2FA where available.
  4. Scan with your security plugin; isolate malware files instead of deleting everything.
  5. Rotate wp-config salts and database password after a confirmed infection.
  6. Repeat the core check for “Remove Wordfence gecrasht – – opnieuw install” from a second network or private window.

Verify

  • No unknown admins.
  • Homepage clean on an external scanner.

  2. Restore from backup only if the live state is corrupt — selectively where possible.
  3. Open a ticket with slug/subject, domain and what you already rolled back.
